hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) NODE_ENV=development ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f"; ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f";; *.json|*.md|*.yml|*.yaml) ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
